clues.text: Joseph of Arimathea laid the body of Jesus in his own new one, cut into the rock.
Early on the first day of the week, the women who came with spices found its stone rolled away.
Peter and the disciple Jesus loved ran to it, and the other disciple outran Peter.
The chief priests and Pharisees had Pilate's guard seal its stone and stand watch there.
Fleeing Moabite raiders, Israelites threw a dead man into Elisha's, and he came back to life.
Isaiah rebuked the steward Shebna for chiseling one out for himself high in the rock.
Preaching in Jerusalem, Peter said that King David's was still with them to that day.
